scope: two classical-data application papers; bounded numerical replications, not complete hardware reproductions

alloys.replay_pca: full SVD with legacy U-based deterministic sign convention
alloys.replay_preprocessing: max over all rows, PCA and StandardScaler on train, MinMaxScaler over train+test as in pinned script; contamination explicitly retained only for author replay
alloys.controlled_classical: raw-feature L2 logistic, RBF-SVC and histogram boosting; shared train-only preprocessing and validation selection
alloys.success_boundary: archived statistics, fresh numerical score agreement, and stronger-baseline superiority are separate claims

communications.connectivity: complete upper-triangular graph, as connected Fig. 3 branch
communications.additional_controls: validation-tuned causal polynomial-delay logistic regression and delay-window MLP, each nine candidates
communications.sampling: exact unconditional density dynamics, S=infinity; no hardware or finite-shot trajectory reproduction
communications.numeric_limit: the upstream message generator is unseeded; fresh random messages cannot reproduce its exact printed numbers

reporting: retain every prescribed seed and model; no outcome-dependent tuning or seed removal; record warnings, failures, predictions, provenance and cost
